title: PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_RECEIVE fails with PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_RECEIVE_SRC_NO_TRUST
pattern: A transaction whose PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_RECEIVE operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (src_no_trust). Sending NRV from an account without an NRV trustline.

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
